snippets.title: Sprint Planning Template
snippets.code:
# Sprint Planning Framework

## Sprint Goal
Clearly defined objective that aligns with quarterly OKRs

## Capacity Planning
- Team velocity: Average last 3 sprints
- Available hours: Team size × sprint days × 6 hours
- Buffer: 20% for unplanned work

## Story Breakdown
1. Review backlog prioritization with PO
2. Break epics into user stories
3. Estimate using Planning Poker
4. Assign stories to sprint based on capacity

## Definition of Done
- Code reviewed by 2+ engineers
- Unit tests: >80% coverage
- Integration tests passing
- Documentation updated
- QA approved
- Product Owner accepted

snippets.title: 1-on-1 Structure
snippets.code:
# Weekly 1-on-1 Framework

## Agenda (30 minutes)

### Personal Check-in (5 min)
- How are you feeling this week?
- Any personal updates or blockers?

### Project Status (10 min)
- Current sprint progress
- Technical challenges
- Collaboration feedback

### Career Development (10 min)
- Skills you want to develop
- Learning opportunities
- Career goals alignment

### Action Items (5 min)
- Review last week's action items
- Define new action items
- Set clear owners and deadlines

## Follow-up
- Document in Confluence
- Share with skip-level manager quarterly
- Track career development progress

frontend.name: Team Organization
frontend.code:
# Engineering Organization Structure

## Frontend Teams (3 teams, 18 engineers)
- Team Alpha: Customer-facing applications (6 engineers)
  - 1 Tech Lead, 2 Senior Engineers, 3 Mid-level Engineers
- Team Beta: Internal tools (6 engineers)
  - 1 Tech Lead, 2 Senior Engineers, 3 Mid-level Engineers
- Team Gamma: Design system & components (6 engineers)
  - 1 Tech Lead, 1 Staff Engineer, 2 Senior Engineers, 2 Mid-level Engineers

## Backend Teams (4 teams, 24 engineers)
- Team Delta: API Gateway & Authentication (6 engineers)
- Team Epsilon: Business Logic & Services (6 engineers)
- Team Zeta: Data Platform (6 engineers)
- Team Eta: Infrastructure & DevOps (6 engineers)

## Platform Team (1 team, 10 engineers)
- Platform Engineering (10 engineers)
  - 1 Engineering Manager
  - 2 Staff Engineers
  - 3 Senior Engineers
  - 4 Mid-level Engineers

backend.name: Performance Management
backend.code:
# Quarterly Performance Review Process

## Self-Assessment (Week 1)
Employee completes:
1. Goals review from last quarter
2. Key accomplishments
3. Challenges faced
4. Skills developed
5. Goals for next quarter

## Peer Feedback (Week 2)
Collect feedback from:
- 2 peers on the same team
- 1 cross-functional partner
- 1 direct report (for managers)

## Manager Review (Week 3)
Manager assesses:
1. Technical skills (Code quality, System design, Problem-solving)
2. Collaboration (Communication, Teamwork, Mentorship)
3. Delivery (Velocity, Quality, Reliability)
4. Leadership (Initiative, Ownership, Impact)

infrastructure.name: Hiring Process
infrastructure.code:
# Engineering Hiring Process

## Stage 1: Recruiter Screen (30 minutes)
- Background and experience
- Salary expectations
- Culture fit

## Stage 2: Hiring Manager Screen (45 minutes)
- Deep dive into resume
- Technical background
- Problem-solving approach

## Stage 3: Technical Assessment (90 minutes)
- Live coding exercise
- System design discussion
- Code review simulation

## Stage 4: Team Interviews (3 hours)
- Technical Deep Dive (60 min)
- Collaboration & Communication (60 min)
- Culture & Values (60 min)

devops.name: Onboarding Program
devops.code:
# 30-Day Onboarding Program

## Week 1: Orientation & Setup
- Meet with Engineering Manager
- Setup development environment
- Join team channels
- Meet onboarding buddy

## Week 2: First Contributions
- Pair programming with senior engineer
- Fix a 'good first issue' bug
- Attend team ceremonies

## Week 3: Real Work
- Pick up a small user story
- Write tests and documentation
- Deploy to staging

## Week 4: Independence
- Own a medium-sized feature
- Participate in code reviews
- 30-day check-in with manager
